examples.title: Twisted squares
examples.description: Forty squares in MODE 1, each a little smaller and a little more turned than the last, build a spiral out of nothing but straight red, yellow and white lines.

examples.title: What day was it?
examples.description: Type a day, a month and a year and the machine works out the weekday with Zeller's congruence; try 1 12 1981, the month the BBC Micro first shipped.

examples.title: Catch the star
examples.description: Steer the paddle with Z and X to catch each falling star; the stars speed up as your score grows, and SPACE starts a new game after a miss.

manuals.title: BBC Microcomputer System User Guide
manuals.note: Acorn's own manual, October 1984 edition, with the complete BBC BASIC reference; PDF scan
